name: Robin and the Frosted Bauble
description: A bright-eyed robin perched beside a large engraved glass Christmas bauble, frosted holly, pinecones and tiny warm fairy lights on a snowy windowsill

name: Lamb in the Easter Orchard
description: A young woolly lamb asleep beside a wicker basket of intricately decorated Easter eggs under flowering pear trees, dew on grass, distant cottage

name: Raven at the Apothecary
description: An elegant raven on a stack of antique botanical books inside a candlelit apothecary, potion bottles, dried herbs, spiderwebs and a moonlit gothic window, no skulls or faces

name: Foxes beneath the Rose Arch
description: Two foxes curled together beneath an intricate climbing-rose arch, scattered petals, heart-shaped ivy leaves and soft afternoon garden light

name: Sailing into 2027
description: An ornate brass nautical compass and a small engraved 2027 medallion beside a folded sea chart, distant fireworks reflected in a harbour through a cabin window, no people

name: Safe in the Foxgloves
description: A mother fox sheltering two small cubs among tall foxgloves and delicate ferns, dappled light, richly detailed fur

name: The Quiet Chess Table
description: Carved wooden chess pieces on a beautifully worn chessboard beside a leather-bound journal, reading glasses and a brass desk lamp, oak leaves beyond the window, no people

name: Sunflowers and Winter Squash
description: A stoneware pitcher of sunflowers with delicately ribbed winter squash, walnuts, dried corn and wheat on a farmhouse dresser, autumn light

name: The Mushroom Forager Gonk
description: One whimsical fictional gonk gathering wild mushrooms with a wicker basket in a fern forest, tall floppy patchwork hat entirely conceals eyes, round nose visible above thick beard, boots and leaf cloak, no other people

name: Kingfisher at the Reed Pool
description: A kingfisher with exquisitely detailed feathers perched over a reed-fringed pool, ripples, dragonfly, weathered branch and reflected reeds

name: Raccoons Clockwork Airfield
description: An original charming cartoon raccoon aviator repairing a whimsical clockwork biplane on a meadow airfield, tool chest, tiny robot assistant, distant hangar and clouds, no humans

name: Stardew Valley — Harvest Greenhouse
description: Recognisable Stardew Valley fan artwork: the restored greenhouse beside the farmhouse with giant pumpkins, starfruit vines, ancient fruit and a little farm cat, Pelican Town mountains behind, naturally integrated Stardew Valley title, no humans
